name: When should I consider upgrading my gas line to my water heater?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading my gas line to my water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading your gas line if your existing water heater is very old and you're replacing it with a new, higher-BTU model that requires more gas flow. Additionally, if you're experiencing insufficient hot water, or if a licensed plumber identifies your current gas line as undersized or corroded during an inspection, an upgrade may be necessary. Safety concerns due to an aging or damaged line are also a primary reason for replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider upgrading if installing a higher-BTU water heater, experiencing hot water issues, or if an inspection reveals an undersized, corroded, or unsafe gas line.
